General comment on data set: Group Folding door wooden and wooden with aluminium cladding is triple-glazed and has a thermal transmittance of 0,98 W/(m2*K). The dimensions (height x width) are made according to the customer's requirements. The calculation is based on the assumption that LCA results are scalable for the desired door dimension. The product is manufactured in Ventspils, Latvia, and marketed internationally. Technology description including backgro: This EPD covers the Group Folding wood and wood-aluminium clad doors. The folding doors are customized building components with folding door mechanisms. A folding door is a type of door which opens by folding back in sections or so-called panels. Dimensions (height x width) are adapted according to customer's requirements. The results are an average of the whole group. The Group Folding Doors includes the following products: Folding doors – Wood; Folding doors – Wood with aluminium cladding. The manufacturing contains the following processes: Extraction and delivery of raw materials; Cutting and profiling; Impregnation; Assembly of frame; Priming and painting of frame; Assembly of complete product; Packing and delivery.
